title: Re-releases of Wing Commander, Ultima titles hit Steam and GOG
summary: It's mostly bad news from EA lately, but preservation efforts are nice to see.
llm_summary: EA’s recent missteps have been making headlines, but on the bright side, classic space‑sim “Wing Commander” and several “Ultima” RPGs are getting fresh releases on Steam and GOG. These re‑launches not only bring the games to modern PCs but also help preserve a slice of gaming
